issues.description: The solution changes the signature of Milkable.messageOnMilk to accept a double parameter (messageOnMilk(double volume)), while the problem statement and the template expect a no-argument method messageOnMilk() that returns a String (and Main in the template calls m.messageOnMilk() with no arguments). This method-parameter mismatch will prevent students from matching the specified API and from compiling/running the provided Main usage, causing confusion about the correct interface contract and the expected return value format.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem/template by changing the Milkable interface and its implementations to messageOnMilk() with no parameters returning String, and update the implementations to return the expected text (e.g. "Seal Clarabelle is milked"). Alternatively, if a volume parameter is intended pedagogically, update the problem statement, UML, and template Main usage to declare and call messageOnMilk(double volume) consistently.

issues.description: The problem statement and template expect a Milkable.messageOnMilk() method with no parameters and a return format of "[Animal Type] [name] is milked". The solution repository defines Milkable.messageOnMilk(double volume) and implements Goat and Seal accordingly (including volume in the returned string). This signature and format mismatch prevents students from directly mapping the described interface and example usage (calls to messageOnMilk() with no arguments) to the provided solution code and would cause compilation/usage confusion.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem statement and template by changing the Milkable interface and its implementations to messageOnMilk() with no parameters and returning the expected format. Concretely: (1) modify Milkable to declare String messageOnMilk(); (2) update Goat and Seal to implement messageOnMilk() returning "Goat|Seal [name] is milked"; (3) adjust any example calls (Main) accordingly. Alternatively, if the volume parameter is intended, update the problem statement and templates to require messageOnMilk(double volume) and document the expected return format including the volume.
